prompt:
I'm building a simple product catalog for an e-commerce site. Each product has a name, price, category, and description. I'm trying to decide between DynamoDB and MongoDB. What are the main differences I should consider for this use case? The catalog won't change much after initial setup.

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

The response considers the stated characteristic that the catalog will not change much after initial setup.
